_comment: wiki ingest accepts a type:question entity built from a questions[] array. Previously the entity validator allowed only entity/concept/decision and hasContent ignored questions/quotes/decisions/ideas — even though buildBodyFromSpec renders all of them — so a question card was rejected (write/ingest asymmetry). This asserts the question card is created with a [question] body line. Provenance auto-stamps from the top-level source (no inline ^[...] needed).

entities.title: Is offline RL safe under distribution shift?

questions.body: Does offline RL stay safe when the deployment distribution shifts away from the logged behavior data?
